video_caption: The video segment opens at 0:05 with a medium shot of a woman with long, dark, wavy hair, wearing a bright pink top, speaking directly to the camera. She appears to be indoors, with a wooden bookshelf filled with books, a small gold trophy, a framed picture, and a miniature Eiffel Tower visible in the background to her left. Below the bookshelf, there is a wooden cabinet. She uses her hands expressively as she talks. A yellow text overlay at the bottom of the screen reads, "WHY DID YOU SELECT THIS UNIVERSITY?". At 0:15, the scene transitions to an animated title card on a light yellow background. The text "TOUGHEST VISA QUESTION" appears in bold dark blue at the top. Below it, a thin dark blue line is present, followed by a circular icon featuring the American flag. Another dark blue line separates this from the red text "F1 VISA FALL 2022" at the bottom. Around 0:19, the text changes slightly to just "VISA FALL 2022" before the card fades out.

In the video segment, a woman with dark, wavy hair, wearing a vibrant pink top with embroidered details, sits in a chair and directly addresses the camera. Her facial expressions are animated and engaging as she speaks, often using hand gestures to emphasize her points. Behind her, a wooden bookshelf filled with books, a framed picture, and a small Eiffel Tower replica is visible on the left, while a part of a black office chair and a light-colored wall are seen on the right.

At the 00:00 mark, a smartphone screen overlays the left side of the frame, displaying a YouTube channel titled "Visa & Flying Tips," with several video thumbnails featuring the woman. Below the main video, there's a red "SUBSCRIBE!" button with a thumbs-up icon and a bell icon. An Instagram icon with the handle "@shachi.mail" is present at the bottom right of the screen. As she continues speaking, the phone display changes at 00:08 to show five stacked rectangular frames, each with the text "F1 VISA SERIES" and an American flag icon. Each frame also has a specific subtitle: "BASICS & MUST KNOWS", "REAL INTERVIEW EXPERIENCES", "ALL ABOUT FUNDING", "DOCUMENT CHECKLIST", and "INSIDER TIPS & TRICKS TO CRACK F1 VISA INTERVIEW".

Around 00:22, the phone overlay disappears, and text appears at the bottom of the screen. First, "HOW TO ANSWER MOST FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTION" is displayed, followed by "WHY DID YOU PICK THIS UNIVERSITY?" at 00:28. The woman explains the difficulty of answering this question, and at 00:38, the text on screen changes to "“UNIQUE ANSWER”". A few seconds later, at 00:43, this text is replaced by "“TOO GENERIC”". From 00:50, a white text box containing a bulleted list titled "November - 12th KOLKATA VISA - REJECTED University - New England College Program- Health Informatics VO - Chinese Guy https://t.me/f1interviewreviews" appears on the left side of the screen, recounting an F1 visa interview experience. The woman points to this text box with her right hand. Yellow arrows highlight specific questions in the list: "2. Why this university?" and later, "6. Why only this university why not other universities? there are plenty of universities that provide health informatics with his hand wide open...". She continues to look at the text on the screen while talking, using hand gestures.

The video segment opens with a split screen, showing a light-skinned woman with dark, wavy hair and a bright pink off-shoulder top on the right side, speaking directly to the camera and gesturing with her hands. On the left side, there's text visible from a list of questions and answers, primarily questions 6 through 11. Question 6 asks, "Why only this university why not other universities?" and continues with details about health informatics and course structure. Question 7 asks, "What did you do since then?", with the answer "Working as a General Dentist at Clinic." Question 8 asks, "Then you quit your job and going for masters now?", to which the answer explains an ultimate goal to "provide quality and better healthcare services to patients to improve this EHR is beneficial in doing it manually sorry Electronically." Subsequent questions (9-11) inquire about a sister in the USA, her activities, and her husband's profession and visa status. As the video progresses, the split screen disappears, and the woman occupies the full frame from her chest up. She continues to speak animatedly, using hand gestures, while the text "DO'S & DON'T'S" in white with a red outline appears at the bottom center of the screen, emphasizing a point she is making about answering questions. Behind her, a wooden bookshelf filled with books is visible on the left, and a white wall/door is on the right.

A woman with long, dark, wavy hair, wearing a vibrant pink top, is speaking directly to the camera, gesturing slightly with her left hand. In the bottom left corner of the screen, a large purple number "1" appears, followed by the yellow text "AND INCLUDE THEM IN YOUR ANSWER". Behind her, a wooden bookshelf filled with books, a golden trophy, a framed picture, and a small Eiffel Tower figurine is visible. To her right, a black office chair and a child's green and black tricycle are in the background.

In this video segment, a woman with long dark hair and a bright pink ruffled top speaks directly to the camera from a well-lit indoor setting, featuring a wooden bookshelf filled with books and decorations, and a child's green and black trike in the background. Initially, she gestures with her hands as text overlays appear on the screen, first "3 USING TOO MANY ADJECTIVES", then phrases like "FACULTY IS GREAT", "COURSE IS AMAZING", "EXACTLY WHAT I WAS LOOKING FOR", and "EXCITED TO JOIN THIS UNIVERSITY", illustrating common mistakes in answering university application questions. She uses expressive hand movements, spreading her hands wide to emphasize points. At 0:42, the text "HOW NOT TO ANSWER" appears on screen. The scene then shifts to a split screen at 0:50, with the first woman (labeled "WHY DID YOU PICK THIS UNIVERSITY?") on the left and a second woman with long dark hair in a navy blue shirt, speaking from an indoor setting with a window and a large TV behind her, on the right. As the second woman answers the question, she is accompanied by red 'X' symbols appearing on either side of her frame and text overlays, sequentially displaying "BORING FACTS", "TOO MANY ADJECTIVES", and "INFORMATION FROM WEBSITE", indicating undesirable elements in her answer. The video then cuts back to the first woman at 1:12, who concludes the segment, speaking and gesturing with a smile.

In a medium shot, a young woman with dark, wavy hair and wearing a bright pink top looks directly at the camera. She points her right index finger upwards then quickly moves it downwards, speaking animatedly with a friendly expression. An overlaid yellow "thumbs up" emoji is visible in the bottom-left corner. Behind her to the left, a wooden bookshelf filled with various books, a small golden trophy, a framed picture, and a small Eiffel Tower figurine are visible. To her right, a black office chair and a child's green and black bicycle/scooter are in the background against a light-colored wall. From 0:04 to 0:13, white text appears at the bottom of the screen, stating, "COMMENT BELOW WHAT YOUR PROGRAM IS."
